confidence_level.description: Legacy route metadata confidence only; never a calibrated decipherment probability.

route_integrity_confidence.description: Confidence that the recorded route or mapping is correctly bound to its source and evidence.

hypothesis_probability.description: A calibrated task-specific probability only; a model self-score or route confidence must not populate it.

hypothesis_probability_status.description: State of any hypothesis probability. Use calibrated only with a locked calibration reference.

hypothesis_calibration_ref.description: Stable reference to the registered calibration report; required when a calibrated probability is present.
